# Log Dog Timberworks

> Hand-cut timber frame pergolas, pavilions, arbors, trellises and hand-hewn beams in the Denver metro and along the Front Range of Colorado. Built from solid 7x7 and 8x8 Douglas Fir (cedar or Douglas Fir for arbors) with mortise and tenon joinery and drawbored oak pegs instead of bolts.

Run by two friends, Chad and Miles. Every build is modeled in 3D, laid out at full scale, and cut by hand.

## Services
- [Pergolas and pavilions](https://logdogtimberworks.com/pergolas-pavilions/): solid Douglas Fir frames over decks, hot tubs and patios; gazebos, greenhouses and sheds
- [Arbors and trellises](https://logdogtimberworks.com/arbors-trellises/): cedar or Douglas Fir arbors, garden arches, wedding arches, gates, planter boxes, trellises with built-in benches
- [Hewn beams and mantels](https://logdogtimberworks.com/hewn-beams-mantels/): logs hewn into beams with a broadaxe; mantels and benches; customer logs welcome

## About the work
- [Process](https://logdogtimberworks.com/process/): site visit, 3D model, full-scale layout, raising; drawboring explained
- [Selected work](https://logdogtimberworks.com/work/): photo gallery
- [Journal](https://logdogtimberworks.com/journal/): project notes from Golden, Erie, Arvada and a cedar trellis with a bench
- [Service areas](https://logdogtimberworks.com/service-areas/): Denver metro and north to Fort Collins

## Notes
- For most Denver suburbs, structures under about 200 square feet (roughly 14x14) do not need a permit. Rules differ by city.
